pack.name: Clonedivers Forge
pack.notes: Clonedivers r22 (v2.1.3): Restored all missing/culled Clone helmets & armor pieces (32 TINY_MESH_AABB units including RS-89/CPG-48/CPH-26, 6 patch_33 @52 LocalTransform units including CM-09 Sev/212th & CW-4, DS-10 material, and 6 unmodded stock helmet slots); compacted all 5 >64-bone GPU palette units; and added realistic CIS Providence-class Dreadnoughts & Vulture Droids vs Republic Venators orbital skybox with crimson-vs-blue broadsides across all 5 performance tiers.
pack.statusNotes: Verified across all 5 tiers (full, lighter, reduced1024, reduced512, potato256) with 0 duplicate keys, 0 missing dependencies, 0 codec mismatches, and 100% unit_safe + runtime LEGO pins preserved.
